[autotest] Cleanup result collection in run_suite.py Perform the following refactor operations: - Move crbug URL logic to reporting_utils.py - Deduplicate logic for getting wmatrix urls - Extract output_buildbot_links() method in ResultCollector. - Setting of output_dict in main(). - Fix typos. The overarching goal is breaking up ResultCollector. ResultCollector is a God class which encapsulates all aspects of collecting test results, formatting URLs, constructing output dicts, etc. It should be broken up into multiple classes and functions. However, making such a change in one commit would be unfun to review, so it will be broken up into atomic chunks, each of which preserve code correctness. BUG=None TEST=Run run_suite_unittest.py and run_suite.py locally and Change-Id: I1d43f4b9560dc34a5387a7922963a69c5b54fdcb Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/386679 Commit-Ready: Allen Li <ayatane@chromium.org> Tested-by: Allen Li <ayatane@chromium.org> Reviewed-by: Allen Li <ayatane@chromium.org>

cr50: clean up the binary installation ebuild It turns out that emerging chromeos-cr50 causes a tarball directory created in the board's file system root. This patch does away with using cros-binary eclass, using different means to accomplish the same goal: install the cr50 binary in the appropriate file system location. Also stripping off some trailing newlines. BUG=none TEST=ran emerge-kevein-tpm2 chromeos-cr50 the ebuild succeeds and /build/kevin-tpm2/opt/google/cr50/firmware/cr50.bin shows up, but the top level directory does not get created. Change-Id: I1d3730ff3be4dc0dd3d8068159c6f41ec56478d1 Signed-off-by: Vadim Bendebury <vbendeb@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/387827 Reviewed-by: Mike Frysinger <vapier@chromium.org>
